_note: Phase 1.0 deliverable: 20 founder-authored golden questions against Nutragroup. This file ships with 5 scaffold templates so the runner is exercisable end-to-end. Replace and expand to 20 in the founder authoring sprint.

questions.question: Why are conversions down on B0CABCD123 this past week?
expected_facts: must compare conversion rate week-over-week with cited numbers
must reference Buy Box ownership OR inventory state OR price as one candidate cause
forbidden_facts: must NOT mention competitors by name
must NOT use placeholder strings like 'SKU-A' or '$XYZ'

questions.question: Returns on B0CWXYZ987 jumped this week. Why?
expected_facts: must read the return-reason text and name a pattern
forbidden_facts: must NOT refuse without reading available return-reason data

questions.question: Did our April ad spend increase on B0CMNOP456 actually drive sales, or did we just burn cash?
expected_facts: must compute and cite ACoS or ROAS
must hold a position on whether the spend was efficient
forbidden_facts: must NOT punt with 'depends on your strategy'

questions.question: Which Nutragroup SKUs need re-buying this week?
forbidden_facts: must NOT recommend re-buying without citing inventory + velocity

questions.question: Anything weird in yesterday's Orders?
expected_facts: must summarize order count + value vs trailing baseline
must explicitly say 'nothing material' if true
forbidden_facts: must NOT manufacture an anomaly to look useful
